Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Diagnosis is
cervical strain. Over the course of care the patient attended 27 visits for conservative management, including manual
therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment followed a usual and expected course, with frequency
tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion increased. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly
confirm the soft tissue injury to the neck. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Whether the
presenting injury is fully attributable to this collision remains to be determined, as the timing and mechanism are still
under review. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated charges identified.
Patient is currently discharged from active care with instructions to continue self-directed exercise and return if
symptoms recur.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
